title: Product Engineering Interview
summary: Prepare for a product engineering coding and architecture deep dive with an evidence-aware research brief, a plain JavaScript drill, durable AI workflow design, 18 checkpoint questions, and a 75-minute mock interview.
audience: Experienced product and backend engineers preparing for interviews covering coding, design, and production ownership.

units.title: Research and Role Fit
units.summary: Evaluate interview evidence, clarify role expectations, and prepare useful questions without relying on company-specific assumptions.

units.title: Plain JavaScript Under Pressure
units.summary: Bound preview work, suppress obsolete outcomes, and test lifecycle failures without a framework.

units.title: Durable Jobs and Revenue Safety
units.summary: Trace accepted jobs, charges, collaboration, and recovery through concrete failure boundaries.

units.title: The 75-Minute Mock Interview
units.summary: Rehearse coding, architecture, and ownership with evidence checks and an anchored self-assessment.
